result.description: The Trustee for R & C UNIT TRUST   Leading Hand Formwork Carpenter     Reports to : Project Manager / Site Manager   Direct Reports:  Carpenters / Apprentice / Construction Labourers / Trade Assistants       Position Summary   The Leading Hand Formwork Carpenter is responsible for carrying out hands-on formwork carpentry works while providing day-to-day supervision and guidance to small site crews on major energy infrastructure projects. The role involves constructing, installing and dismantling formwork systems, interpreting engineering drawings, coordinating daily work activities and ensuring works are completed safely, efficiently and in accordance with project specifications, quality standards and Work Health and Safety requirements.   Key Duties and Responsibilities   •    Read and interpret engineering drawings, specifications and construction plans for formwork and reinforced concrete structures.   •    Measure, cut, assemble, erect and dismantle timber, plywood and engineered formwork for footings, slabs, columns, walls, beams and other concrete structures.   •    Construct, install and maintain formwork systems in accordance with project specifications, Australian Standards and quality requirements.   •    Inspect completed formwork to ensure correct dimensions, alignment, bracing and structural integrity prior to concrete placement.   •    Carry out repairs, modifications and adjustments to formwork and temporary structures as required throughout the construction process.   •    Operate and maintain hand tools, power tools and construction equipment safely and efficiently.   •    Supervise and provide day-to-day guidance to a small team of carpenters and labourers, allocating tasks and monitoring work progress to ensure quality workmanship and timely project delivery.   •    Coordinate daily formwork activities with engineers, site supervisors, steel fixers, concreters and other trades to support efficient project outcomes.   •    Monitor the quality of completed carpentry works and rectify defects where required to ensure compliance with project specifications.   •    Assist with planning material requirements and ensure the safe handling, storage and use of construction materials on site.   •    Maintain a clean, safe and organised work area by identifying and reporting hazards and ensuring compliance with Work Health and Safety (WHS) legislation, Safe Work Method Statements (SWMS) and company policies.   •    Complete works within project timeframes while maintaining high standards of workmanship, safety and quality.   Skills, Experience and Qualifications   •    Certificate III in Carpentry (or equivalent overseas qualification), or a higher relevant qualification.   •    Demonstrated experience as a Formwork Carpenter.   •    Proven experience constructing, installing and dismantling formwork systems for reinforced concrete structures.   •    Experience supervising or leading small site crews and coordinating daily construction activities.   •    Sound ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, construction plans and technical specifications.   •    Strong knowledge of formwork systems, construction methods, Australian Standards and quality requirements.   •    Proficiency in the safe operation of hand tools, power tools and construction equipment.   •    Sound understanding of Work Health and Safety (WHS) legislation, Safe Work Method Statements (SWMS) and safe work practices.   •    Strong communication, leadership, teamwork and problem-solving skills with the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced construction environment.   •    Ability to work across multiple project locations, including FIFO/DIDO assignments, as required.   •    Current Construction Induction (White Card) and a valid driver's licence.  •    Additional industry licences or tickets (e.g. Working at Heights, Elevated Work Platform, Dogging, Rigging or First Aid) are advantageous.     About Company     About T&S Construct   T&S Construct is an Australian construction company specialising in formwork, concrete and structural construction services for major civil and energy infrastructure projects. Initiate pre-project risk assessment/review and communicate findings to Key Stakeholders as applicable

Organisational and time management skills
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
Strong attention to detail
Ability to work autonomously and as part of a team
Interpersonal and communication skills
Able to communicate with several departments to evaluate and improve operations

(Reso Scaffold)
16 Prospect Place, Boronia VIC 3155

Full Time Architectural Draftsperson
$95,000 + superannuation

Summary
Smart Hill Construction Pty Ltd, trading as Reso Scaffold, is a growing construction company specialising in residential, commercial and industrial building projects. As the business continues to expand its design-and-construct capability, the company requires an experienced Architectural Draftsperson to prepare detailed architectural documentation, support project planning and coordinate technical drawings throughout the construction process.

Our Architectural Draftsperson will be responsible for preparing architectural drawings and construction documentation, interpreting design concepts, coordinating technical information and supporting the delivery of residential and commercial construction projects. The position provides specialised drafting support across the business and contributes to efficient project delivery, design coordination and regulatory compliance.

Duties and Responsibilities

Design Documentation and Drafting
•	Prepare architectural drawings, plans, elevations, sections and detailed construction documentation using CAD, Revit and BIM software
•	Translate architectural concepts, sketches and design specifications into accurate technical drawings for construction purposes
•	Revise and update drawings to reflect design changes, engineering requirements and client variations throughout project deliver

Project Documentation and Coordination
•	Prepare documentation required for planning approvals, building permits and construction documentation packages
•	Coordinate architectural drawings with structural, civil, mechanical and other consultant documentation to minimise design conflicts
•	Maintain project drawing registers, revision histories and document control throughout each stage of construction

Technical Design Support
•	Interpret building codes, Australian Standards and planning requirements when preparing architectural documentation
•	Assist with material selections, construction detailing and specification preparation to support project outcomes
•	Produce 3D models, presentation drawings and visual representations where required to assist project coordination and client communication

Stakeholder Liaison
•	Liaise with Architects, engineers, project managers, consultants and clients to clarify design requirements and technical information
•	Coordinate drawing revisions and technical documentation arising from project meetings and consultant feedback
•	Support communication between design and construction teams to facilitate efficient project delivery

Quality Assurance and Compliance
•	Review drawings to ensure accuracy, completeness and compliance with project specifications and applicable regulations
•	Maintain drawing standards, templates and documentation procedures in accordance with company quality systems
•	Assist in resolving design documentation issues during construction and support continuous improvement of drafting processes

Assessment Criteria
•	A relevant qualification in Architectural Drafting, Building Design, Architectural Technology, Architectural Interior Design or a closely related discipline, or relevant industry experience

result.description:
Seven Corp on behalf of Adelaide Steel Frame Windows

Overview: 

Adelaide Steel Frame Windows is South Australia’s largest manufacturer of architectural steel doors and windows. Operating successfully for over 24 years, our continued growth has led to a recent expansion into a larger facility in Regency Park. We take immense pride in our craftsmanship, solid work ethic, and supportive team culture.

We are seeking a dedicated, full-time Metal Machinist / CNC Specialist to join our production team. In this role, your primary responsibility will be setting up, programming, and operating precision tools and machinery to shape high-tolerance steel components for our bespoke architectural doors and windows.

This position is ideal for a precision-focused tradesperson with comprehensive experience in both complex manual milling and turning operations alongside advanced CNC programming. Working alongside our workshop floor team, you will enhance productivity, ensure strict quality control, troubleshoot manufacturing challenges, and assist in mentoring apprentice team members.

Main Tasks:

-	Interpret complex technical drawings, blueprints, and engineering specifications to determine job requirements, tooling needs, and sequence of machining operations.
-	 Set up, program, and operate a variety of machine tools including CNC processing machines, lathes, milling machines, and precision grinders to shape steel components.
-	Calculate engineering parameters, feed rates, and cutting speeds; check fabricated components for conformity and extreme precision using micrometers, calipers, and gauges.
-	Embrace daily tradesperson challenges to diagnose, troubleshoot, and enhance overall machining and manufacturing processes.
-	Work closely alongside the workshop floor team to achieve optimal assembly timeframes, minimise material wastage, and maintain high-quality project outcomes.


Required/Relevant Qualifications & Work Experience:

-	Minimum AQF Certificate III in Engineering - Mechanical Trade (Machining)
-	A minimum of one year of full-time proven professional experience setting up, programming, and operating both CNC and manual metalworking machinery, or
-	At least 3 years of relevant experience as a Metal Machinist to substitute the formal qualification.
-	Forklift license 
-	White card
-	Current driver’s license.

Required/Relevant Skills & Knowledge:

-	Demonstrated ability to write, edit, and optimise CNC programs (G-code/M-code or conversational) at the machine control panel.
-	High proficiency in traditional manual turning, milling, drilling, and surface grinding techniques.
-	Advanced skill in using precision measuring instruments (micrometers, height gauges, dial indicators, calipers) to hold tight tolerances.
-	Sound understanding of metal properties (specifically structural and architectural steel grades), insert selection, speeds, feeds, and coolant applications.
-	Strong spatial awareness and ability to convert complex 2D/3D engineering drawings into finished physical components.
-	Strong diagnostic skills for troubleshooting machining chatter, tool wear, and alignment issues.
-	Pride in producing clean, accurate, and repeatable craftsmanship suited for premium architectural applications.

If you are a motivated, Metal Machinist looking to become a critical part of our leading steel frame manufacturing business, please submit your resume and a brief cover letter outlining your machinery experience, CNC programming capabilities, and alignment with our team values via the application link.

Annual salary will be between $75,000.00 to $85,000.00 (plus superannuation) depending on level of experience.

Job Types: Full-time, Permanent
